_comment: A multi-turn support conversation that is long enough to benefit from coarse-to-fine attribution. Each speaker turn is a natural coarse segment; the decisive evidence is buried inside one of the customer turns. Run with: jev-xray explain examples/mock_multiturn.json -q refund_requested --method drill --provider langsmith
state:
Customer: Hi, I received order B-221 three days ago and the packaging was torn open on arrival. The contents looked okay at first glance.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your order. Can you describe the item condition in more detail?
Customer: I went to use it this morning and the screen has a crack that wasn't there when I bought it. It must have happened in transit. I paid $340 for this and I expect it to work. Your website promises damage-free delivery.
Agent: I completely understand. Damage in transit is covered under our policy. I can offer a replacement or a full refund.
Customer: A refund please. I don't want a replacement because I found a better deal elsewhere. Process it back to my original payment method.
Agent: Understood, I'll process that now. You should see the refund within 3 to 5 business days.

refund_requested.instructions: The customer has explicitly asked for a monetary refund.

criteria.true: The customer stated or clearly implied they want money returned
criteria.false: The customer wants a replacement, information, or has not asked for money back

agent_resolved.instructions: The agent has already committed to a resolution in this conversation.

outcome.instructions: What resolution was agreed in this conversation?

criteria.investigation: The issue was escalated for further investigation
